aim_summary.goal: Increase the overall height of the whole frame structure by 0.5 cm while preserving its area profile.
preserve_targets: area profile of the frame structure
aim_summary.expected_outcome: The complete frame is 0.5 cm taller, with its existing section profile and unrelated geometry unchanged.

operations_plan.summary: Extend the complete frame body by 0.5 cm from a planar terminal seating face while continuing the unchanged face section.

steps.description: Extend SOLID 0 by 0.5 cm along the outward normal of the terminal seating face, preserving all outer and inner profile loops.

expected_result.geometry: SOLID 0 has an overall height 0.5 cm greater than its original height, with the selected terminal face section continued unchanged.

validation_criteria.description: The final overall height of the whole frame structure exceeds its original overall height by exactly 0.5 cm.
The extended region reproduces the complete original terminal face profile, including its outer boundary and inner opening loops.
Frame geometry not required for the height increase remains unchanged.
